results.content: We are happy to announce that Aidalos and Norwegian Public Roads Administration has signed an agreement for a pilot project, using our technology to continuously analyse sensor data from Kolomoen Bridge (https://lnkd.in/dyh8\_FiR). We’ll explore how this tool is changing the way architects think about materials, structure, and sustainability, and how data-driven design can help us create truly low-carbon buildings. ✅ The PDR confirmed: ·        A consolidated set of requirements to feed the next project phase (Phase-C → CDR) ·        A design maturity fully aligned with ECSS standards for Preliminary Design Review ·        Significant technology development progress, supported by successful breadboard and engineering model testing ·        A refined system architecture, including: ·        Optimized CAD layout and mechanical definition of key structures ·        Updated avionics (HMS & sensors) and functional architecture ·        Detailed mechanical/electrical interfaces and preliminary harness design 💡 With the PDR successfully completed, the ICARUS project is now entering the Phase-C, heading toward the Critical Design Review (CDR) planned to be held in December 2026.
